mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(h.view_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS `date`, COUNT(*) AS pv, COUNT(DISTINCT h.user_id) AS uv FROM t_history h WHERE h.view_time >= #{from} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(h.view_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY `date` ASC
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(o.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS `date`, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM t_order o WHERE o.create_time >= #{from} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(o.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY `date` ASC
SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(g.category_name, ''), '未分类') AS name, COUNT(*) AS `value` FROM t_goods g GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(g.category_name, ''), '未分类') ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

SELECT o.goods_id AS goodsId, COUNT(*) AS soldCount, SUM(o.amount) AS amount FROM t_order o WHERE o.status IN ('pending_ship', 'shipped', 'received', 'completed') GROUP BY o.goods_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, SUM(o.amount) DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT SUBSTRING_INDEX(a.action, '.', 1) AS name, COUNT(*) AS `value` FROM t_audit_log a GROUP BY SUBSTRING_INDEX(a.action, '.', 1)
